propositions: when the epic-close bug screen encounters an LLM provider error (e.g., Bedrock ValidationException), it currently degrades the failure to verdict C ('unrelated') instead of propagating the error, causing a systematic outage to silently blind the caused_by bug floor with no signal in verdict, sidecar, or exit code

the per-candidate exception handler in epic_bug_screen.screen_candidates._row swallows LLMUnavailableError via a broad except Exception clause and converts it to a degrade-open verdict, preventing the worker pool from surfacing provider failures
epic_bug_screen.run_screen's advisory shield (broad except) also swallows LLMUnavailableError before it can propagate to the close gate's fail-closed handler

operator decision requires provider errors (LLMUnavailableError and its subclass LLMConfigError) to BLOCK the close with nonzero exit and an error message naming the failure, consistent with the absent-provider fail-closed path, while non-systemic per-candidate failures continue to degrade open
non-provider per-candidate failures (malformed output, store read errors, runtime errors) must continue to degrade to C, preserving the documented degrade-open behavior only for systemic outages

the fix must re-raise LLMUnavailableError at both the warm-call and fan-out seams in screen_candidates._row and at the run_screen outer shield, while leaving all other exception classes to degrade, ensuring the workflow interpreter fails the precheck step and the close gate's existing handler blocks the close
